children: Truist Securities maintained their Buy rating on Travelers Companies's stock with a price target of $435.00.
The price target implies an upside of 11.7% from the Oct 16 close of $389.54.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Travelers Companies reported robust core income of $9.18 per diluted share, significantly exceeding market expectations, driven by higher net investment income and favorable prior year development. This consistent financial strength reinforces investor confidence.

: With the stock trading at 12x earnings, below its historical average, and supported by a diversified business model in both commercial and personal insurance, Travelers is well-positioned to outperform in a competitive market, justifying the Buy rating.
